name: Battle of Pitdown
description: Battle in which goblins and giants slaughtered both armies.

timeline.summary: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashions the first bone flute from Lord Ursnell's left leg.
timeline.quote: Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.

citation.text: Bone Flute (The Dark, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Flarg goblins surprise-attack the forces at the Battle of Pitdown.
timeline.quote: they made a surprise attack on the fighting forces of Ghed and Alsoor

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Terisiare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah joins the army and survives the Battle of Pitdown by hiding in a Fountain of Youth.
timeline.quote: he has to hide in a Fountain of Youth to avoid being killed by goblin raiders
